title: Petition of W.T. Holmes Transportation Co., Inc., pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 11A, requesting the Department to approve the amendment of its Charter License No. 18997 by deleting the present restriction and by substituting therefor a restriction which which limits the authority under the Charter License to trips originating originating in the Towns of Norfolk, Wrentham, Plainville, Franklin, Medway, Mansfield, Foxborough and Millis.
